subject: [PATCH 2/5] mm/huge_memory: dequeue the deferred split after the split freeze

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Zi Yan noted that the patch affects another contributor's (Kairui) cleanup series and requested it be picked up before Kairui's larger series.

Gave Reviewed-by
reviews.raw_body:
+Kairui, since the change affects his cleanup series. I assume this will
be picked up sooner than Kairui's large series.

2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of __folio_freeze_and_split_unmapped in the Linux kernel's huge_memory module. It removes a workaround that was previously necessary due to issues with deferred_split_isolate, and instead unqueues the folio from the deferred split list after it has been frozen and its memory control group is still set. This change ensures that the PG_partially_mapped flag is cleared after splitting, which is necessary for accurate statistics tracking.
